name: @inid/react
description: Sign-in with InID for React: <SignIn />, <UserButton />, useUser() and friends. Talks to your server's InID routes (see @inid/nextjs).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --external:react --outfile=dist/index.js && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --jsx react-jsx
